User hm947 does not have write permissions

[github run](/anomalyco/opencode/actions/runs/30725057720)
supermemory is perfect for this and it can be hosted locally without needing to connect to any third party servers.

I would recommend hosting supermemory locally on your machine if you do not want to connect to any more third party services. however their hosted environment is a great starting point to learn how to interact with the service. pretty much solves the agent memory need and can be bundled up and carried across almost every llm/agent/platform you use. they also provide ample documentation and SDK's to implement the service wherever you want where they don't already have native built in plugins or you can't connect via an MCP server.

Confirmed on OpenCode 1.17.10, macOS, using Anthropic Claude.

Auto-compaction triggered at 103% context usage and failed with `tool_use` IDs missing immediately following `tool_result` blocks. Retrying produced the same error and left the session unusable.

I checked the local session database: both referenced tool calls were marked `completed` and had stored outputs. This suggests compaction/request construction separated valid tool calls from their results, rather than the tools being interrupted.

The logs show the failure occurred in `agent=compaction`.

This issue might be a duplicate of existing issues. Please check:
- #37443: Auto-compress context and retry on context_length_exceeded errors — very similar feature request for automatic context compression
- #32040: Context Compact Ratio — requests configurable compaction ratio, overlapping with the `autoCompactThreshold` idea
- #38851: Compaction triggers around 30–35% with a specific model — discusses compaction threshold behavior

If your request is meaningfully different from these, please clarify what's distinct.

I'd like to take this one, following the simpler direction mentioned above.

My plan is a TUI-only fix with no server event or API changes: when `/undo` picks the revert boundary in `packages/tui/src/routes/session/index.tsx`, skip inputs that have been admitted but not yet promoted into `session_message`, and fall back to the most recent promoted user message instead. That way `session.revert.stage` is never called with an ID the server cannot resolve, and a visible-but-unpromoted input is simply not offered as an undo boundary.

I'll first reproduce locally with the steps in the report, then add regression coverage along with the fix.

Addressed by the V2 external TUI plugin runtime work, specifically commit fe91698ed6721dd3ace96e901cabec3d03815d7b (`fix(tui): initialize external plugin runtime`) and its Bun runtime guard f599f8f3d3022deb496bc238d0d3694f1ce5df9d. The TUI now calls OpenTUI runtime plugin support configuration before importing external modules, so plugin JSX shares the host renderer context instead of throwing `No renderer found`. The subsequent component-semantics and hot-reload suites exercise external plugin slots/routes in the real TUI runtime. Closing as resolved.

Addressed by #39945. The unreachable `AssistantMessage` renderer and its transitively dead `ExplorationSummary` helper were removed while the live row-based assistant, tool, reasoning, retry, grouping, and footer paths remained intact. Focused session-row tests and the TUI typecheck passed. Closing as resolved on the v2 branch.
